# graphiant_playbook_job (Data Source)

A single Automation Workflows playbook job, by job id or as the latest job for a config. Timestamps are RFC 3339 (UTC).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Latest job for a config; use job_id instead to look up a specific job.
data "graphiant_playbook_job" "latest" {
  config_id = graphiant_playbook_config.ntp.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config_id` (String) Look up the latest dry-run/pipeline job for this config instead of a specific job.
- `job_id` (String) Job to look up. Exactly one of job_id or config_id is required.

### Read-Only

- `collection_version` (String)
- `config_description` (String)
- `config_name` (String)
- `deploy_ended_at` (String)
- `deploy_started_at` (String)
- `dry_run_ended_at` (String)
- `dry_run_started_at` (String)
- `failed_phase` (String)
- `logs_available` (Boolean)
- `post_deploy_check_started_at` (String)
- `run_duration_ms` (Number)
- `run_ended_at` (String)
- `run_number` (Number)
- `sdk_version` (String)
- `started_by_user_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `verbose_logs` (Boolean)
